title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode5 Taking a Break

meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In the peaceful light of the ever-shining sun in the days of spring...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Already?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, Airi!
You're so quick!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't even know which card to reach for...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Minori!
We just started!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku...!
Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We can beat them if we try really hard!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The color of the flower has already faded away while in idle thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Got it!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
How?!
I thought I could get this one...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Next, we'll be playing Fukuwarai!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Shizuku, would you like to go first?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good luck, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm, is this... An eye?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooo! Shizuku, that's a cheek...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shush, Minori! Don't say anything until everything's in place...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it really is hard to stay quiet during this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's you guys...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, no. It's nothing.
Keep going, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay then... What could this be...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm guessing this is the mouth? I put an eye here, so the mouth should go... Here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wh-What?! There?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku's so... Bold...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be fair, she is blindfolded...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Finished! How did I do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's straight out of a horror movie...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It's like a Picasso painting! I like what you did with it, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Man, I don't even know where to start with this one...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sigh... I'm spent...
But that was fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was a nice change from what we usually do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We were so into it, we completely forgot about the camera sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it was great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait... NOOO! I forgot we were recording too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Welcome to the club, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What do we do?! We had it all planned out so neatly, and I went off script right there...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't beat yourself up over something like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. Why don't we see how the video turned out?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This video's great!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Everyone's having so much fun playing those games!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but this is a bit embarrassing... I put a cheek where an eye should be and the mouth where the nose should be during Fukuwarai...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were all really on edge when you did that...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was really worried because it didn't all go as we planned...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it actually turned out pretty well in the end, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's like this with live shows too. You can plan all you want, but things never really follow the script while the cameras are rolling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, it's usually better when you're just yourself and go with the flow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Spoken like a true professional, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Weren't you thinking the same, Haruka? I mean, I'm sure that's why you let things go off script the way they did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, that was part of it but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone was having so much fun, I wanted to preserve that vibe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe! You all look so happy and enthusiastic in the video!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you can't help but smile while watching it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku and Rin!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I wish I hadn't made such silly mistakes in front of the camera, but if you liked the video, then I'm happy with it too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. And it was a good learning experience!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, that was a good test run. How about we take what we learned from it and work out what we'll do for the real thing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka, before you go, would you like to stay here a bit longer and have some fun?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're celebrating the New Year, so it would be great if we could spend more time chatting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to try Fukuwarai too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm. We have been crazy busy lately, so maybe we should just take it easy for a change...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We can draw up our plans whenever so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's celebrate the New Year together!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
